thread:
Maya Patel: Quick heads-up 1 I'm opening a PR to reorganize the Console Observability samples so tracing, dashboards and cost examples are easier to find. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/492
Sam O'Neill: Nice. Can you add a short migration note for dashboards v1 -> v2? Call out metric renames + default time-window change.
Maya Patel: Yep, adding docs/console/migrations/dashboards-v2.md with a checklist for SDK and dashboard owners.
Priya Desai: Reminder: SDK param changed from `trace_key` to `traceKey` in 0.8.0. We should show both in snippets or note compatibility.
Maya Patel: I'll include a dual-snippet and a compatibility tip.
Diego Ramos: Cost API path changed; samples using `/v1/costs` need `/v2/costs/summary`. Also `unit_cost` was renamed to `cost_per_token`.
Maya Patel: Updating the cost snippet and leaving a migration note for telemetry teams.
docs-bot: lint:docs-samples failed on console/samples/tracing/README.md line 42 - use 2-space indent for nested lists.
Maya Patel: I'll run the local linter and fix before pushing.
Priya Desai: For trace-hook example: include an explicit trace id header example and show sending it with SDK and raw HTTP. Eg:
```
# header example
Authorization: Bearer <token>
X-Trace-Id: 123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426614174000
```
Diego Ramos: Also note sampling default (0.1) so folks don't expect full traces. Link to runtime sampling docs.
Maya Patel: Will add sampling note and a link to observability/sampling.
Sam O'Neill: For the folder move, prefer a deprecation banner rather than symlinks. But keep index pages for searchability with a clear "moved to" callout.
Maya Patel: Plan: move `console/samples/{tracing,costs,dashboards}` -> `console/observability/{tracing,cost-breakdown,dashboards-v2}`, add deprecation banners for 3 months and a redirect table in top-level README.
qa-bot: checklist: run sample smoke tests, verify YAML lint, confirm snippet output matches expected trace keys, validate links under docs.redwood.ai/console/*.
Maya Patel: Smoke tests locally show one failure in cost sample due to `unit_cost` -> `cost_per_token`. Fixed snippet.
Priya Desai: Ping me before merging, I'll run the SDK snippets against 0.7.x and 0.8.0 to ensure compatibility.
Maya Patel: Will do. ETA: pushing branch today EOD; merge tomorrow if CI green.
Sam O'Neill: After merge open follow-up PR to update console TOC so observability folder is visible.
Maya Patel: Yep. Also adding a "what changed" blurb for release notes.
Diego Ramos: Two stale links left in console/tracing/README.md pointing to the old tracing agent repo. Replacements: https://docs.redwood.ai/tracing/agent and https://docs.redwood.ai/observability/sampling
Maya Patel: Added replacements, pushed branch. CI kicked off. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/492
Sam O'Neill: :thumbsup: I'll watch CI and merge if green.
Maya Patel: Thanks all, will list changed paths for release notes after merge.
Priya Desai: Awesome, thanks Maya.
Maya Patel: End of thread.
